scope: Enquiry in-app UI (enquiry screen, list, pricing setup, onboarding). Not yet applied: copy to the app root as tokens.lock.json when the build starts.

color.notes: Things' own muted greys (#8e9196 = 2.89:1, rgba(0,15,36,.46) = 3.14:1 on #f2f5f7) fail WCAG and are NOT adopted. Secondary text uses #55606e (5.84:1 on bg, 6.39:1 on card); fainter meta uses #5f6670 (5.30:1 on bg, 5.80:1 on card). Accent stays violet (5.79:1 on bg, 6.34:1 on card; white on violet 6.34:1).

typography.heading_style: regular-weight large headings (h1 24px/400 on mobile); bold reserved for small labels

spacing.rhythm: generous; one idea per block, wide margins, list rows breathe

motion.notes: Quiet. No scroll-triggered entrances on the reference; keep transitions short and functional.

layout.pattern: single centered column, one primary action, content in white rounded cards on a soft grey ground

mapping_to_current_tokens.headings (semibold/bold): -> regular weight, larger size; bold only for small labels
